_pass: Summary pass · 2 Sep 2026. n/55 refreshed off the 55-row cards for all 20 names; Mean, Proposed, My correction and FINAL added.
_rule: letter = the row's '✍️ My correction' when that cell is filled, otherwise its 'FINAL' cell. The correction column overwrites everything to its left. An empty correction means that row has not been ruled on yet, so FINAL stands. Compute never writes a letter.
_meanRule: Read mean next to n, never alone. The mean is unweighted, so a thin card with one lucky Aligned mark outranks a wide card with an honest spread. That is why coverage — n out of 55 — is printed beside every letter and why the mean is never shown on its own.
_notScoredRule: Two different things were being called OUT. A candidate who has filed but published nothing to score is not the same as someone who is not running, and collapsing them reads as a judgement on the first. notScored carries the first; out carries the second. Notion's Alignment compute still lists all five in one OUT table — reconcile it there.

candidates.name: Krista Loughton

candidates.name: Melissa Cseszko

candidates.name: Karen Rothe

candidates.name: Wendy Bowkett
candidates.summary: Four exact instrument matches: permit priority, crisis response, economic plan, Local Area Plans. Silent on tax cap and household bill.

candidates.name: Bella Lee
candidates.summary: Fourteen scored cells, every one at Close, across housing, tenants, transit, parks, policing. Nothing on downtown order, Host Nations or Hall efficiency.

candidates.name: Jack Sandor
candidates.summary: Broadest challenger platform, matching program instruments on housing, transit, washrooms, crisis response, integrity. No tax cap or household bill position.

candidates.name: Martin Girard

candidates.name: Peter Gibbs

candidates.name: Shona Dion

caveats: Times Colonist returns 403 on re-check, so Alto row 1 of 55 and Gardiner rows 13, 52 and 55 rest on an earlier retrieval.
The City has published no minutes since 11 June 2026, so the 25 June amalgamation, 23 July cooling and 30 July items rest on agendas plus media rather than recorded divisions.
Caradonna row 13 is not name-verified. If the 7 May 2026 recorded vote names him it becomes Opposed −1.0.
Kim has no candidate-owned 2026 platform, so her card rests on the slate site.
Ten names crossed the five-answer line since the letters were last applied, so several rows carry a correction rather than an older applied letter.
